rationale: City of Greater Geelong Development Engineer (Band 6, fixed term to 30 September 2027); asks for a tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering, which Marc's BSCE meets, and no minimum years are stated.

Core work is checking subdivision road and drainage drawings and overseeing construction; Marc's Advanced Diploma road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D plus his site inspections and drawing reviews in the Philippines overlap well.
Geelong is about an hour from Melton, and the fixed term to September 2027 sits inside his Subclass 485 work rights to December 2027.
caution: Band 6 is above graduate level and the panel may prefer local government or Australian subdivision experience; Marc has neither yet, and his design work is coursework rather than paid production work.
gaps: No local government or statutory authority experience
No Australian subdivision plan checking experience; design work is Advanced Diploma coursework
Has not worked under the Subdivision Act or planning permit processes
